subject: Demo for StrataScale — need to adjust timing due to conflicts
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@stratascale.com>, Carlos Jimenez <carlos.j@stratascale.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Demo kickoff — Oct 20 10:00 PT (initial invite)

Hi Elena / Carlos,

Thanks again for the time — looking forward to walking through Redwood’s inference platform and how it maps to StrataScale’s workload. I’ve scheduled a 45-minute demo for:

  • Tue, Oct 20 • 10:00–10:45 AM PT

Ava will run the technical walkthrough and highlight batching/quantization recommendations. I’ve attached a calendar invite and the doc you asked for (StrataScale_ProdReqs.pdf) so Ava can tailor the demo to the right infra concerns.

Attachments: redwood-demo-invite.ics (calendar), StrataScale_ProdReqs.pdf (design notes)

If that time doesn’t work, tell me what’s better and we’ll pivot.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@stratascale.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Jimenez <carlos.j@stratascale.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo kickoff — Oct 20 10:00 PT (initial invite)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks — heads up that our lead infra engineer (Maya) is out of office for an offsite on Oct 20. We realized after confirming that she’s the one we want on the call for the architecture section.

Would you be able to move the demo to either:
  • Wed, Oct 21 — late morning (10:30–12:00 PT window)
  • Thu, Oct 22 — early morning (8:30–10:00 PT)

Carlos is traveling on the 22nd but can dial in if we do the 21st. Sorry for the late change — our calendar sync failed us.

Thanks,
Elena
Director of ML | StrataScale
elena@stratascale.com

From: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@stratascale.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T10:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo kickoff — Oct 20 10:00 PT (initial invite)

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads-up.

I want to be transparent: I’m scheduled for a mandatory internal training all day on Oct 21 (we only found out last week), so I won’t be available in the 10:30–12:00 PT window on the 21st. Oct 22 early morning looks workable for me, though — I can do 8:30–9:30 PT.

If the team prefers the 21st, Dev offered to cover the demo on short notice (he knows the StrataScale deck and ran a similar architecture walkthrough last month). I’m happy to handoff notes and jump on the Q&A at the end if needed.

Also: if shifting is tight, I can record a 6–8 minute targeted demo clip of the quantization/batching section and share it ahead of the live call so the team has something to review.

— Ava
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ava@redwood.com | +1 206-555-0112

From: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@stratascale.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo kickoff — Oct 20 10:00 PT (initial invite)

Hi all — I can take the 21st slot.

If we pick Wed, Oct 21 I’m available 11:00–12:00 PT and can run the full technical demo. Quick ask for Elena/Carlos: can you confirm whether you want the demo to focus on "throughput/cost" or "latency/SLOs" primarily? I’ll tailor the walkthrough — otherwise I’ll cover both at a high level and deep dive into the latency optimizations if you have capacity to discuss KV cache behavior.

I’ll also need the final attendee list so I can pull the right examples.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@stratascale.com>, Carlos Jimenez <carlos.j@stratascale.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo kickoff — Oct 20 10:00 PT (initial invite)

Elena — thanks for the quick updates and everyone for the options.

Recap of availability:
  • Wed Oct 21 — Dev can run at 11:00–11:45 AM PT (Dev available)
  • Thu Oct 22 — Ava can run at 8:30–9:15 AM PT (Ava available, Carlos traveling)

I’ve attached a quick screenshot of the two proposed slots (proposed-times.png) to make picking easier. If you want the in-person engineer present, go with Oct 21 — otherwise Oct 22 is fine too.

Please confirm which slot you prefer and I’ll update the calendar invite (or send an updated ics). Should I make this 30 or 45 minutes? Recommend 30 unless you want the architecture deep dive.

-Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: proposed-times.png

Hi Karthik / Dev —

Thanks — Wed, Oct 21 at 11:00 AM PT works best for us. Please send the updated invite as a 30-minute meeting and add a calendar phone-in for Carlos (he’ll be on the road but dialing in).

Attendees we expect: Elena Ruiz (Director of ML), Carlos Jimenez (Sr. Platform Eng), Maya Patel (Lead Infra Eng) — Maya will join in person.

Appreciate the flexibility. Looking forward to the walkthrough.

Best,
Elena
